notes.title: List of Games + FAQ!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Infinite Alliance, everyone! Thank you all so much for the incredible support and excitement we've seen over the last few days.

I've noticed a lot of similar questions popping up, so I wanted to take a moment to share answers in a proper Steam post.

Infinite Alliance is a story rich, turn-based JRPG crossover, uniting 13+ indie games in a FREE adventure! 

It's coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch 1 & 2, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox One, & Xbox Series X|S in 2026!

It's free?
It is! This project has been created to showcase and celebrate the work of the Indie JRPG scene (even though we're just a small portion of what's out there). So we didn't want any barriers to entry, as we hope players will discover some new favourite games through this collaboration. That's why we decided to make it completely free for everyone!

On Steam, the goal is for it to be 100% free. On consoles, we're required to offer some kind of purchases, and so we'll have a handful of optional DLCs. All proceeds from these purchases will go to charity.

So how can I support the project?
I've been incredibly humbled by how many people have asked me this. The best way to support Infinite Alliance is to buy and wishlist the games involved.

9 games on the list below have already been released on Steam (with several on console too), and the 5 upcoming titles would love your wishlists! Quartet is launching in August, and another 3 games are targeting a 2025 release. So we all greatly appreciate your support! 😊

Which games are involved in this project (so far)? Links?
13+ Indie Games are involved in Infinite Alliance, with more announcements to come! I'll list them in alphabetical order, in case anyone's looking for something specific.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017620/Beloved_Rapture/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664240/Venaitura/
Do I need to have played all the games to understand Infinite Alliance?
Not at all! Infinite Alliance has been written as an introduction to these characters and their games, so no prior experience is necessary. We hope to intrigue new players through strong story-telling and gameplay.

Are any more games going to be announced for this collaboration?
Yes! While you've seen the bulk of the titles involved, we still have a few more surprises to reveal closer to release. Their involvement will be a little different from what you've seen so far, but it'll add to the celebration and hopefully create even more excitement 😊

Who's behind Infinite Alliance?
We have an amazing team of artists, composers, and creatives working on Infinite Alliance, all supported by our wonderful publisher Electric Airship: https://electricairship.com/games/infinite-alliance/

Director/Game Designer/Writer - Joshua Hallaran
Key Art and Logo - Steph Sybydlo
Battle UI, Portraits, and Enemy Sprites - Loyal Haylett Jr
Character Art - Jason Perry
Environment Tiles - W. James Pandelis (SodaPiggy), with assistance from John Fuhrer
Battle Animations - Anthony Alfonso
Backgrounds - Steven McCarthy
Composers - Sebastián Cruz (Carfonu), Eddie Marianukroh, Tyler Mire, Sam English, & Dimitry Kochegura (Mushra)
Sound Design - Sam English
Programmer - Ryan Van Dyke
Mapping - Aaron T. Crawford and Joshua Hallaran
Original Visual Mock-Up - Tim Wendorf
Can I listen to that *amazing* trailer theme?!
Sam English, the incredible composer, has uploaded it to his Youtube channel - please check it out!

[previewyoutube=yGcEhTMCt_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
And if anyone has any more questions, please feel free to ask in the comments below! Or join my Discord. It's for the 8-Bit Adventures series, but we have an interserver channel for Infinite Alliance connecting several communities from the games involved!

Discord: https://discord.gg/aKf2tr4

Thank you for all of your support and please look forward to future updates 😊
~Josh
